plain: A likeness between two things that are otherwise different.

webster.text: An agreement or likeness between things in some circumstances or effects, when the things are otherwise entirely different.

more.text: With grammarians, analogy is a conformity of words to the genius, structure or general rules of a language.

example.quote: The reasoning on this head has been abundantly exemplified by the experience of all federal constitutions with which we are acquainted, and of all others which have borne the least analogy to them.
